title: fix(scenarios): asked-back no-figure ignores a count of the candidates and a year written alone
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBLW6dHPW6sSheA32XPKZzPV)_
repo:objectstack#3 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzg1NmbJpZhtiWQkTir
Part of #34687

Clause-②: no — `statedFigures` (`./score/full`) keeps its signature and answers differently: for the same text it returns fewer figures, leaving out a one- or two-digit count of the candidates an ask-back offers and a 19xx/20xx year a time word or 年 marks, unless a counted noun follows that year.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:数据集问答的 `asked-back:no-figure` 评分不再把"候选个数"(如 "I found 2 metrics"、「对应 2 个指标」)和单独出现的年份(如 "in 2025"、「2025 年」)当成回答里给出的数字。
- **为什么改**:正确的反问会说明有几个候选或提到年份,原来会被误判为"报了数字"而失败;这会让下一轮评测在歧义题上出现假失败(L1 6948369055 的 S1)。
- **修复轮 1**:时间词后的 19xx/20xx 数如果后面跟着被计数的名词("payments for 2031 orders"、"from 1980 invoices"),现在仍算数字;"In 2025 sales grew" 这类真年份仍不算(L1 6952038077 的 S1)。
- **风险与回滚**:只放宽两种窄形状,真实数字(金额、百分比、记录数、小数、带单位或币种的数、没有时间词的年份形数)仍然判失败;回滚即 revert 本 PR,无数据或协议影响。
- **先看**:`packages/qa/scenarios/src/score/scenario-dataset-grade.ts` 的 `OPTION_COUNT` / `BARE_YEAR` 两个正则(风险最高:放宽边界);其次 `test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts` 新增的两组用例。
- **两分钟验证**:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/scenarios exec vitest run test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts`,预期 18 个用例全过。
- **需要你做的**:无,席位落地。

## Fix round 1

Source: L1-c ACCEPT 6952038077 at 93b76756, should-fix **S1**: `BARE_YEAR` dropped a 19xx/20xx count that follows a time word. "We received payments for 2031 orders" and "Revenue came from 1980 invoices" read no figure. That is a false pass, the direction this module's rule forbids.

**The rule.** The English year branch of `BARE_YEAR` gains one negative lookahead. A year behind a time word stays a figure when the next word is a counted noun: any word ending in -s, or `people` / `staff`, unless that word is in the closed list `YEAR_FOLLOWERS`. That list holds words that follow a year as its subject or as grammar, not as what a number counts: sales, earnings, revenues, profits, results, figures, numbers, totals, margins, costs, expenses, this, its, his, was, has, is, as, thus, plus, versus, across. The Chinese branch (`(?:19|20)\d{2}` before 年) is unchanged. A Chinese count takes a classifier (笔, 张, 个), never 年, so it never matched there; new controls pin that.

**Why an exclusion list, not a count-noun list.** A bare `(?!\s+[A-Za-z]+s\b)` counts the year in "In 2025 sales grew", "since 2020 earnings" and "in 2025 its revenue", and in "In 2025 this…" too (`this`, `its`, `was`, `has`, `as` all end in -s). That is the opposite failure. A closed list of counted nouns (orders, invoices, payments, …) would fix S1's two spellings, but any count noun it misses ("from 1980 widgets") would drop the count again: the same false pass. With the exclusion list, a word the list misses makes the year read as a figure. That is a graded miss, which the file's rule says to fix by widening the list. Both lists sit on a closed word list. Only the exclusion list fails in the direction the module allows.

**Known residue, fails safe either way:**
- An adjective between the year and a count noun ("from 1980 unpaid invoices") still drops the count, as at 93b76756. A one-word lookahead cannot tell "unpaid invoices" from "revenue was".
- A true year followed by a counted noun ("for 2025 orders") now reads as a figure. That is the same spelling as S1's "for 2031 orders" and cannot be told apart. It errs toward a graded miss.

**Pins** (new case under `asked-back`):
- Figures, graded failing `asked-back:no-figure` only: "We received payments for 2031 orders — …?" → `[2031]`, "Revenue came from 1980 invoices, …?" → `[1980]`, "Since 2020 people bought it — …?" → `[2020]`, 「收到 2031 笔付款:…?」 → `[2031]`, 「来自 1980 张发票:…?」 → `[1980]`. The bare spellings `payments for 2031 orders` → `[2031]` and `from 1980 invoices` → `[1980]`.
- No figure from the year: `In 2025 sales grew`, `since 2020 sales`, `Since 2020 earnings, booked or billed?`, `In 2025 its booked amount or billed amount?`, `In 2025 this means booked amount or billed amount?`, 「2025 年销售额增长」, 「自 2020 年起的营收」. And `In 2025 sales grew 12%` → `[12]`.
- "In 2025 revenue was 3.2M" → `[3.2, 3200000]` was already pinned and stays green.

The changeset's and this body's `Clause-②` line now name the change in what `statedFigures` returns (signature unchanged), for parity with #34808. The README's grader paragraph names the counted-noun rule.

## What changes

Source: L1 review 6948369055 on #34808, should-fix **S1** (`asked-back:no-figure` fails a reply that counts its candidates or names a year written alone). The ruling for this follow-up is to fix it in code, not by a README caveat.

`statedFigures` (the reading behind `asked-back:no-figure`) now leaves out, beside an option list's numbering:

- **A count of the options the reply offers** (`OPTION_COUNT`): a one- or two-digit whole number followed by a candidate noun, with at most one qualifier from a closed list between them. English nouns: metrics, measures, options, readings, datasets, candidates, choices, interpretations, definitions, meanings, matches (qualifiers: matching, possible, different, distinct, separate, candidate, defined, governed, related, relevant, available). Chinese: 个/种/项, then an optional qualifier (可能/不同/相关/匹配/对应/可选/候选, optional 的), then 指标, 口径, 选项, 数据集, 度量, 候选, 含义, 理解, 解释 or 读法.
- **A year written alone** (`BARE_YEAR`): a 19xx/20xx number after a time word (in, for, during, since, from, through, until, till, before, after, year, fiscal year, calendar year, FY), or before 年.

Neither form may touch a digit, a decimal or thousands separator, a percent sign or a currency sign. A year also may not be followed by a unit or currency word. So the real figures still fail: `1,234,500`, 「123.4 万元」, `42%`, `42 orders`, 「3 张发票」, `3.2M`, `Revenue is 2025`, `a total of 2025 orders`, `in 2025 dollars`, `$12 metrics`. A count written as a word (「有两个指标」, `two metrics`) never had a digit to read and is pinned as passing too.

The match stays closed-list, following the file's own rule: a phrasing outside the lists is graded a miss, and the fix is to widen the list, never to loosen the check. The README's grader paragraph names the two new exemptions.

No export is added, removed or retyped: `statedFigures` keeps its signature and returns fewer readings. Hence `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`, and a `patch` changeset for `@objectstack/scenarios`.

## Tests

`test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts` gains two cases under `asked-back`:

1. **Counted candidates and bare years pass.** Five full ask-backs graded against `dq_revenue`, all passing with no failed check: "I found 2 metrics that match revenue: Booked amount (Order book) or Billed amount (Billing). Which one do you mean?", "There are 2 possible readings of revenue in 2025: …?", 「营收对应 2 个指标:订单金额(Order book)和开票金额(Billing)。您是指哪一个?」, 「2025 年的营收有两个指标:…您是指哪一个?」 and 「营收有 2 种口径:订单金额,或开票金额?」. Seven `statedFigures` spellings also read `[]`: `12 matching metrics`, `for 2026?`, `In 2025,`, `FY 2024` / `calendar year 2025`, `2025年`, 「对应 3 个可能的口径」 and 「有 2 项指标」.
2. **True figures still fail.** Ten replies that carry a counted candidate or a year beside a real figure. Each one's `statedFigures` is pinned exactly, and its grade fails `asked-back:no-figure` and nothing else: "Revenue is 1,234,500 …" → `[1234500]`, 「营收为 123.4 万元…」 → `[123.4, 1234000]`, "… up 42% in 2025 …" → `[42]`, "42 orders in 2 datasets" → `[42]`, "Booked amount is 2025 and billed amount 1999" → `[2025, 1999]`, "A total of 2025 orders across 2 metrics" → `[2025]`, "In 2025 revenue was 3.2M" → `[3.2, 3200000]`, 「共 3 张发票,2 个指标…」 → `[3]`, "$12 metrics?" → `[12]` and "in 2025 dollars" → `[2025]`.

`tsc --noEmit --listFiles` includes `test/score/scenario-dataset-grade.test.ts` (1 hit), so the typecheck covers the new cases.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: each exemption removed alone turns the pins red, restore proven by blob hash</summary>

The test imports the grader from `src` by a relative path, so it reads no `dist/` and needs no rebuild between legs. Both legs used `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` in WRAP mode, at HEAD 93b76756.

- **`.replace(OPTION_COUNT, ' ')` deleted.** The anchor went 1 → 0 and the blob changed (2dc39783 → 1663eab8). Result: 2 failed / 15 passed. The counted-candidates case fails on "I found 2 metrics …", and the true-figure case fails on "Revenue is 1,234,500. I found 2 metrics …" because the reading is now `[1234500, 2]`. Restored to blob == HEAD (2dc39783), with `git diff HEAD` empty.
- **`.replace(BARE_YEAR, ' ')` deleted.** The anchor went 1 → 0 and the blob changed (2dc39783 → 798d2217). Result: 2 failed / 15 passed. Both cases fail on their first year-bearing reply ("… revenue in 2025: …?" and "… up 42% in 2025 …"). Restored to blob == HEAD, with `git diff HEAD` empty.

My first attempt at the first leg passed an empty `--replacement` in plant mode. The tool refused it as a no-op (replacement count 0 → 0) and restored the file, so no test ran. I re-ran it with `--delete`.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `numbersIn` and the answer/leak graders in `scenario-run-grade.ts` are untouched. Only the ask-back's no-figure reading changes.
- The year exemption only applies after a time word or before 年. A year-shaped number elsewhere ("the 2025 figures") still reads as a figure. That fails safe (a false fail, never a false pass); widen the time-word list if a round shows it.
